name: DGME medical and dental college lists — Sylhet Division
organization: Directorate General of Medical Education (DGME), Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
attribution: Source: Directorate General of Medical Education (dgme.gov.bd)
notes: Same DGME HTML tables as the earlier division runs: 'সরকারি/বেসরকারি মেডিকেল কলেজ' (college code, name, year established, MBBS seats; page updated 18 Dec 2025) and 'সরকারি/বেসরকারি ডেন্টাল কলেজ/ইউনিট' (updated 20 May 2024). Rows kept when the name's district suffix (or a district name in it) is in Sylhet Division. The MAG Osmani dental unit (listed as 'এমএজি ওসমানী মেডিকেল কলেজ ডেন্টাল ইউনিট', without a district suffix and spelt differently) is attached by hand to college code 15. English names/websites for government colleges come from the 'সরকারী মেডিকেল কলেজ (সকল)' page, matched by district where the district has one government MBBS college (Sylhet, Habiganj, Sunamganj). No addresses, phones or coordinates. Licence not stated.
